resources.string: Side-by-Side feeds 3D glasses. Glasses-Free hands both eyes to the panel, which builds its own views from them and follows your face as you move.

What the host is sending. Side by side is woven as it arrives. 2D is turned into 3D by the converter built into the panel. The 3D toggle in the stream menu still switches between flat and 3D either way.

3D runs the screen at full brightness. On this panel it can stay that bright after the stream ends, until the brightness is changed again. Allowing this app to modify system settings lets it put your brightness back by itself when you leave 3D. It only rewrites the brightness you already have.
